qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global alternative asset management powerhouse with €239B AUM (€176.6B fee-paying AUM). Over 80% of capital is locked up in 10-year closed-end fund structures with zero early LP redemption rights, creating an exceptional contractual toll booth. Pricing power demonstrated by raising €26B Fund IX (largest PE fund globally) at standard 1.5-2.0% fee terms and high re-up rates (~90%). Empirical proof: FY25 GAAP ROIC of 45.8%, tangible ROIC >100%, and operating margins >50%. Primary erosion threats: macro liquidity slowdowns delaying portfolio realizations and compressing performance fees.
